wikitext.*: {{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season |year=2020–21 |team=Little Rock Trojans |sport=Basketball |image=Little Rock Trojans.png |image_size=250 |conference=Sun Belt Conference |division=West Division |short_conf=Sun Belt |CoachRank= |APRank= |record=11–15 |conf_record=7–11 |head_coach=[[Darrell Walker]] |hc_year=3rd |asst_coach1=Charles Baker |asst_coach2=Preston Laird |stadium=[[Jack Stephens Center]] |champion= |tourney= |tourney_result= }} {{2020–21 Sun Belt Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2020–21 Little Rock Trojans men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Arkansas at Little Rock]] in the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Trojans, led by third-year head coach [[Darrell Walker]], played their home games at the [[Jack Stephens Center]] in [[Little Rock, Arkansas]] as members of the [[Sun Belt Conference]]. With the creation of divisions to cut down on travel due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], they played in the West Division. ==Previous season== The [[2019–20 Little Rock Trojans men's basketball team|Trojans]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 21–10, 15–5 in Sun Belt play to win the Sun Belt regular season championship. They were the No. 1 seed in the [[2020 Sun Belt Conference men's basketball tournament|Sun Belt tournament]], however, the tournament was cancelled amid the [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]]. Due to the Sun Belt Tournament cancellation, they were awarded the Sun Belt's automatic bid to the [[2020 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]].
